options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

options.doc_fr:

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Determines the victory condition.

Ending A: Reach ending A.
Ending B: Reach ending B.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine la condition de victoire.

Ending A: Atteindre la fin A.
Ending B: Atteindre la fin B.

options.name: Starting Skill
options.doc: Determines which skill you start with.
options.doc_fr: Détermine avec quelle compétence vous commencez.

options.name: Starting Respite
options.doc: Determines the respite you start the game at.
options.doc_fr: Détermine le répit auquel vous commencez le jeu.

options.name: Start With Fast Travel
options.doc: Start with Fast Travel instead of shuffling it into the item pool.

options.name: Start With Healing Ward
options.doc: Start with Healing Ward instead of shuffling it into the item pool.

options.name: Advanced Logic
options.doc: Include Nola, No.7, Reibolg and Incomplete Gear in the logic.

options.name: Central Elevator Fix
options.doc:
Determines requirements to fix the Central Stratum elevator.

Vanilla: Same as the original game.
Key: Find a key shuffled into the item pool.
Free: The elevator is already fixed.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine les exigences pour fixer l'ascenseur du Stratum central.

Vanilla: Comme le jeu original.
Key: Trouvez une clé dans le pool d'articles.
Free: L'ascenseur est déjà réparé.

options.name: Required Steles
options.doc:
Determines the number of steles Lily requires for
'Center 4 - Faintly Glowing Aegis Curio'.

0: Only the Blighted Pupil is required.
1: Vanilla.
2+: Extra steles are required and added to the item pool.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine le nombre de stèles nécessaires à Lily
Centre 4 - Faintly Glowing Aegis Curio.

0: Seul l'élève Blighted est requis.
1: Vanille.
2+: Des stèles supplémentaires sont requises et ajoutées au pool de l'article.

options.name: Progressive Aptitudes
options.doc:
Aptitudes are acquired in order.
Dive -> Motley's Torrent
Lars' Grip -> Lars' Swift Flight
options.doc_fr:
Les capacités sont acquises dans l'ordre.
Plongée -> Le Torrent de Motley
Poignée de Lars -> Vol rapide de Lars

options.name: Meta Progression
options.doc:
Places progression in locations that were just unlocked, so every one you find
leads directly to the next one.

Enabling this keeps every progression item inside your own world.

options.name: Shuffle Transitions
options.doc:
Shuffle area transitions and doors.
Non-door transitions between rooms of the same area are unaffected.

Off: Transitions lead where they should.
Coupled: Returning through a transition will take you from whence you came.
Decoupled: Any transition can take you to any other transition.

options.name: Chapter Scaling
options.doc:
Determines how the chapter value moves between Minimum Chapter and Maximum Chapter.

Vanilla: Raises difficulty when you reach specific points.
Progress: Derived from completion, Minimum Chapter at 0% and Maximum Chapter at 100%.
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer comment la valeur du chapitre se déplace entre le chapitre minimal et le chapitre maximal.

Vanilla: Cela soulève des difficultés lorsque vous atteignez des points spécifiques.
Progress: Extrait de l'achèvement, chapitre minimum à 0 % et chapitre maximal à 100 %.

options.name: Minimum Chapter
options.doc: Lowest chapter value used to scale the game difficulty.

options.name: Maximum Chapter
options.doc: Highest chapter value used to scale the game difficulty.
options.doc_fr: Valeur chapitre la plus élevée utilisée pour évaluer la difficulté du jeu.

options.name: NG+ AI
options.doc: Enemies use their New Game+ AI.
options.doc_fr: Les ennemis utilisent leur nouvelle AI Game+.

options.name: Relic Cost Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffles the equip cost of relics.

options.name: Skill Cost Shuffle
options.doc: Shuffles the materials required to upgrade skills.

options.name: Shuffle Attuner Arts
options.doc: Shuffles Attuner Arts for all skills.

options.name: Allow Multiple Skills Per Spirit
options.doc:
Removes the one-skill-per-spirit limit.
(Logic doesn't account for this)

options.name: Randomize Enemies
options.doc: Replaces the enemies each room spawns with other enemies.

options.name: Randomize Bosses
options.doc:
Replaces each boss with another boss (experimental).
(Lars phase 2 and Rooted Primordial Beast are excluded)

None: Bosses will remain in their vanilla locations.
Shuffled: Bosses will be shuffled amongst each other.
Full: Bosses will be randomized.

options.name: Shuffle BGM
options.doc: Shuffles the background music tracks.
